metadata_recommendations.title: Lost in Translation: Exploiting Unicode Normalization (Slides)

defects.defect: Published Markdown labels this slide deck as a Whitepaper and preserves mainly repeated footer text; screenshot content and diagrams are absent. Full original PDF independently verified and all pages visually inspected.
Character-to-byte branches, byte ordering, normalization paths and account-flow relationships absent; restored as Mermaid plus original visual evidence.
Image-only code, requests, tables, output and highlighted payloads absent; restored with fenced transcriptions and original screenshots.

remaining_uncertainties: Original slide inconsistencies preserved: p21 binary question mark; p38 Overlong < label with > payload; p45/46/52 different 98/89 byte sequences; p47 endian labels as drawn; p68 stray 215 and second IPv4 address; p70/72/77 c$ placement; p78 worts.fit spelling; p86/87 src/scr; p91/92 missing percent sign versus p93 output; p115 missing opening expression brace.
Some original screenshots contain clipped or tiny incidental UI text (p25,37,54,107); crops preserve exactly the available source and no offscreen text was fabricated.
Cover gives the two-day conference range, not an individual speaking date.
review.rendering_verification: Offline Chromium visual QA found missing Unicode glyphs with the container font; semantically equivalent ASCII labels now retain their meaning, with original notation documented in captions and source figures.
